name: Semantic Safety
description: What a reconstruction must never change. These run as before/after comparisons in the meaning checks and outrank every style rule.

rules.name: Figures preserved
rules.description: Every number, amount and percentage survives (3 and three count as equal).

remediation.guidance: Keep every figure exactly as given.

rules.name: Dates preserved
rules.description: Month, weekday and ISO date references survive.

rules.name: Names preserved
rules.description: People, organisations and places named in the source still appear.

remediation.guidance: Keep every name; a pronoun may follow, the name may not vanish.

rules.name: Quotations verbatim
rules.description: Quoted words survive word for word.

rules.name: Links verbatim
rules.description: URLs and email addresses survive unchanged.

rules.name: Negations intact
rules.description: The number of negations stays the same, so no statement flips.

rules.name: Length within target
rules.description: Output length stays inside the style's range relative to the source.

rules.name: Key words kept
rules.description: Enough of the source's content words survive that nothing was obviously dropped.

remediation.guidance: Do not drop claims to change the style.
